title: Hobbies and Interests for Your Resume: What to Write, What to Skip and How to Prove It
seoTitle: Hobbies and Interests for Resume: Examples for India
seoDescription: Add hobbies to your resume only when they prove a job skill. See vague vs specific examples, NCC/NSS/sports certificates that count, and what to leave out.
excerpt: A side-by-side table that turns vague hobbies into recruiter-ready lines, the NCC, NSS and sports certificates that make interests checkable, and the follow-up questions Indian interviewers ask.
